Garlic

tion, whole garlic can be baked or roast-

Nutrient composition
Garlic contains the phytochemicals
allicin, ajoene, saponins, and phenolic
compounds that may have antioxidant
and immune-promoting functions. 
Varieties
Some 300 varieties of garlic are grown
around the world.  In the United States
only two main types, “early” and “late,”
are grown.  About 90 percent of the garlic
is grown in California.  The early variety
is harvested in mid-summer, and the late
variety is harvested a few weeks later.  The
late variety is slightly denser and has a
longer shelf life than the early variety.
Other, rare varieties of garlic are the Chileno
and Elephant garlic, which is actually a
form of leek and has a milder flavor.
